human_release_review.registry_index: optional release_reviews method_id -> repository-relative approved artifact
human_release_review.scope: explicit manual state changes only after bound real evaluation, five verified case types, current regression and human approval; identities, semantic judgement and statistical significance remain externally audited

candidate_relation_binding.required: same method_id and candidate on one reviewed relation, with own upstream claim/trigger and directly quoted source
candidate_relation_binding.writing_candidate: student_draft explicitly recorded on review relation
negative_tests: trigger quote substituted for relation evidence
candidate_relation_binding.scope: structural binding of external assertions; not English semantics or scoring certification

paper_scan.ranking: own eligible case count descending then method ID; not suggestion frequency or demonstration score
paper_scan.gate: closed question plus own verified trigger and own produced artifact or reviewed decision, with no stopped execution for this method
paper_scan.scope: external reviewed structural scan, not legal-source, complete-paper or English-semantic certification

review_provider_binding.input_gate: schema validation before callback and after return
review_provider_binding.snapshot: independent deepcopy detects in-place and nested changes, additions and deletions
review_provider_binding.scope: single question and inherited paper/passage input consistency; not a callback sandbox or semantic certification

student_entry_migration.meaning: static copy completeness, not observed first-use success

evaluation_design_hardening.workflow: declared study freeze / communication freeze / practicality / first-use / blind sequence, with each communication version observed; not authenticated dates
evaluation_design_hardening.short_safety: absolute trigger/action/evidence/transfer/stop gates plus relative boundary/role/stop deltas; bad 90s reference cannot release short versions
evaluation_design_hardening.release: missing workflow or absolute thresholds, any per-version correctness loss or failed blind gate blocks release and efficiency/signature review hints; no automatic Registry promotion

method_execution.scope: external reviewed action results, not an automatic English semantic executor
method_execution.dependency_gate: earlier reviewed complete non-stopped compatible artifacts only
method_execution.binding: current input spans, role/version, named decisions and graph payload fingerprint

single_question_lesson.scope: external reviewed spoken transport, not certified semantic or whole-passage delivery
single_question_lesson.complete_gate: own actions, quotes, candidate relations, stop rules and closed answer
single_question_lesson.seven_five: three reviewed F01 partitions displayed once before body
single_question_lesson.projection_binding: text, method, trigger, candidate relation and current graph spans; unsupported full script withheld

whole_passage_delivery.scope: declared external course order and spoken delivery, not authenticated semantic/old-host performance
order_gate: reading task mode, not passage letter
cloze original-number first pass / observed stop / exact recovery
grammar explicit hint branch then original-number order
seven-five one shared grouping before breakthrough
whole_passage_delivery.complete_gate: every own single-question script and closure, original material, reviewed order; no partial answer string

original_image_review.binding: decoded supplied bytes / sha256 / pixel region / transcription hash / graph payload fingerprint
original_image_review.course_rules: application one-band lowering; continuation explicit discretionary deduction
original_image_review.scope: external visual assertions; original authorship, legibility, communication impact and grading not certified
original_image_review.negative_gate: filename, transcription, unclear image, missing communication impact or material cannot authorize adjustment

writing_score_boundaries.bands: parsed from the same frozen course rubric, not a second table
writing_score_boundaries.word_count: reviewed full-student-draft evidence, quoted course thresholds, supported deduction and before/after arithmetic; actual count remains external
writing_score_boundaries.projection: all scores bind own current-draft / trigger / reviewed relation / verification path and score fingerprint, not only image scores
writing_score_boundaries.scope: course-contract consistency, not certified English grading
